result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: The stated reason for building the desert towers was that Uzziah had much livestock. His love of the soil explains why he employed farmers and vinedressers, not why he built towers. The question should also specify the desert towers; the window mentions separate fortified towers in Jerusalem and does not call either set “watch towers.”
